task_title: Fix music play command matching extracting wrong substring
summary: Fixed a bug in process_command where the music play keyword loop would continue iterating after finding a match, potentially causing the song name to be overwritten or missed. The fix restructures the loop to break on the first matching keyword and moves the play/error handling outside the keyword loop.
demo_script: Sir, I fixed a bug in the music play command where multiple keyword matches could interfere with each other. Now the system correctly stops at the first matching keyword and plays the requested song.

changes.description: Fixed music play command matching: restructured the keyword loop to break immediately after the first matching keyword extracts the song name, preventing the loop from continuing to check other keywords which could overwrite or miss the result. The song extraction and playback logic is now outside the inner loop, using the first matched keyword only.
